$comment: Tunable QA thresholds. Read by .github/workflows/nightly-compliance.yml. Review cadence and adjustment rules are in docs/quality.md.

coverage.note: floor is enforced in ci.yml via --cov-fail-under. Raise it only when headroom (observed - floor) stays above the threshold for a full release cycle, and never above observed minus 5.

live.note: The live suite hits a third party, so a single failure is not proof of upstream drift -- transient network errors and rate limiting look identical. Retry before alarming. Raise retries only if false alarms recur; each retry is another round of traffic to an unofficial endpoint.
